item_short_desc: Rothco Skull & Crossbones Headwrap protects your head and neck from the sun  and is great for keeping hair out of your face.
description: Rothco Skull & Crossbones Headwrap protects your head and neck from the sun   and is great for keeping hair out of your face. This headwrap can be worn on its own  or under a helmet. The skull cap is soft yet durable. It is made out of 100% cotton composition for comfortable all-day wear.   The headwrap features adjustable back ties to accommodate most heads.
